recordingProfileCapture.artifactIntegrity: all 15 implementation images and 15 measurement records matched manifest byte counts and SHA-256 values
recordingProfileCapture.note: The Nx capture target ran both the app and E2E typecheck prerequisites before completing all 15 states. Every state required a real recording-desktop full-motion WebGL canvas, seed 43117, render readiness, no observed context loss, and an observed screen-composition measurement. All 13 source-applicable copy states, all 12 source-applicable route states, all 7 source-observed landmark states, all 5 source-applicable field states, the independent field-contact center, and journey-exit additionally carry structural evidence records. The two transition-copy states use state-specific visible-ink regions and never infer censored pixels. The source contract uses composition as the primary structure for landing and landing-idle, and field profile as the primary structure for field-approach and field-pulse-a; all 15 source-primary structures are observed. All five implementation field profiles now pass the unchanged source-pixel quality gate and remain measured visual mismatches. Three transferable landmarks and all 12 applicable routes are observed; the reveal and landing-idle packet is decoupled from activation feeder geometry, and eight cyan-family states use renderer-independent localhost classifiers. Four source-mask landmarks, including the complete arrival arrow, are compared with renderer-independent implementation masks; source masks remain reference-only and never classify implementation pixels. Runtime errors, context loss, invalid structural records, and missing composition evidence are hard failures, and the complete size/SHA-256 manifest is published atomically.

currentLiveProfileProbe.qualification: Tablet and mobile are browser emulations, not physical-device or performance evidence. Main-thread context-loss events were monitored; worker and OffscreenCanvas context-loss state remains unknown.

fieldTileProfileEvidence.qualification: The same bright-neutral predicate and component-shape gates measure full visible tile tops in both rasters. Clipped, activated, pulse-recolored, and bloom-obscured tiles are not inferred. All five implementation profiles are observed; each remains a measured visual mismatch.

fieldContactCenterEvidence.qualification: The shared chroma predicate measures only the saturated field-contact center tile. It is independent structural evidence and does not replace the authoritative source-tied tile-plus-standing-figure semantic landmark union.

landmarkEvidence.qualification: Loader, world-reveal, and field-pulse-b use shared transferable chroma masks. Activation-route, activation-contact, field-contact, and arrival-lockup use hash-locked source semantic masks paired with separate renderer-independent localhost classifiers. All seven comparisons are true filled-silhouette evidence and fail the locked minimum.

routeEvidence.qualification: The centerline metric is exact symmetric Euclidean Hausdorff distance over deterministic skeletons of the visible selected route-core masks. It includes parallel rails and branches without inferring a hidden renderer spline.

comparison.reason: The whole four-row landing/journey DOM ladder passes all 13 applicable state contracts; loader-mark and world-reveal have no applicable DOM profile. The unmasked full-frame raster is only a preliminary diagnostic and passes 1 of 15 states. Shared source/implementation algorithms measure all declared structural roles. Composition passes 204/285 checks, copy bounds pass 21/52, field evidence passes 14/45, contact-center evidence passes 0/5, landmark evidence passes 13/35, all 12 observed route cores pass 14/84, and the boundary passes 4/4. The current live bundle source-confirms the Phase 7 world-space route knots and construction; remaining projected route displacement is carried into the Phase 8 static-camera solve rather than distorting that topology. Structural accuracy remains 0 pass / 15 fail / 0 blocked.
